product.title: Custom 3D Bubble Letter Necklace
product.descriptionHtml:
The name you love. A little closer.

Your name, their initials, or two letters that tell your story. This custom 3D bubble letter necklace turns your chosen text into rounded, dimensional charms — a meaningful everyday piece for you or someone you love.

Choose your finish

Keep it polished with Gold or Silver, or add sparkle with Gold Zircon or Silver Zircon. Gallery examples show sample names and initials; your necklace is made with the text you enter.

Make it yours

  1. Choose your finish and character range.
  2. Enter your name or letters exactly as you want them made. Count every character, including spaces and symbols — K&Y is 3 characters.
  3. Check the spelling and selected range, then add to cart.

Choose 1–14 characters. Your text becomes the letter design; this product does not offer engraving.

Length & what is included

  • 18-inch chain with a 2-inch extender, adjustable up to 20 inches.
  • One necklace in your selected finish with your chosen name or letters.
  • Gift packaging and a rose box are not included.

Care for your keepsake

Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth. Remove before showering, swimming, or applying perfume, and store separately. Read our jewelry care guide for more tips.

A thoughtful birthday, anniversary, or just-because gift. For help with a design or a delivery date, contact us before ordering, or explore more necklaces.
